title: My Stupid Mouth
original_lyrics:
[chorus]
- # - # - - - # -
My stupid mouth Has got me in trouble
I said too much again
To date over dinner yesterday
And I could see she was offended
She said "well anyway..."
Just dying for subject change
Oh, - nother social casualty Score one more for me
How could I forget? Mama said "think before speaking"
No filter in my head Oh, what's boy to do
- # - # - - - # -
I guess he better find one soon
We bit our lips she looked out the window rolling tiny balls of napkin paper
I played quick game of chess with the salt and pepper shak - er
And I could see clearly an indelible line was drawn

[bridge]
Oh, the way she feels about me has changed
. . . D7sus4
Thanks for playing, try -gain.
How could I forget? Mama said "think before speaking"
No filter in my head Oh, what's boy to do
I guess he better find one
I'm never speaking up - gain
It only hurts me
I' rather be myste - ry
Than she de - sert me
Oh I'm never speaking up again
- # - # - - - # - . . .
Starting now
One more thing why is it my fault?
So maybe I try too hard

[bridge]
I just wanna be liked, I just wanna be fun - ny
Looks like the jokes on me, so call me captain backfire
Oh, - nother social casualty Score one more for me
How could I forget? Mama said "think before speaking"
No filter in my head Oh, what's boy to do
- # - # - - - # -
I guess he better find one soon
